approved_version.description: The content version another person approved for issue and send; the scheduler issues only while it is the current one.

checks.description: Its statuses (Appendix C.1 #28, #29): every problem the invoice rules find in its content (a missing rate aside, which a draft takes when it is issued), as Templates incomplete (✖); a warning when an occurrence before today has no draft yet, or when it is set to issue and send but its content is not approved; or OK, Paused or Ended.

content_version.description: The version of its content, which drafts name; it changes when the customer, reference, currency, lines or notes change.

customer.description: The customer of each draft, with its name.

edited_at.description: When the current content was written.

edited_by.description: Who wrote the current content: they do not approve the issue of its drafts (SOD-3).

issues_and_sends.description: Whether the scheduler issues and emails its invoices now: set to, and its current content approved.

last_on.description: The last occurrence a draft was made for.

lines.description: The lines of each draft, each with its net.

mode.description: draft: the scheduler makes drafts; issue_and_send: it issues and emails each invoice once the current content is approved.

net.description: Each draft's lines' net, before GST: the GST is worked out on each draft's date.

next_on.description: The next occurrence the scheduler makes a draft invoice for, dated that day; absent once it has ended.

reference.description: The customer's reference on each draft.

status.description: active makes its drafts; paused makes none until it is resumed; ended has no occurrence left.

version.description: The version of the recurring invoice; it makes the ETag.
